dimensions.name: Constructive Proof & 1:20 Detailing
probes: Where is the thermal break at the parapet and slab edges?
What is the vapor barrier sequence and hygrothermal breathability?
How are dimensional tolerances and seasonal expansion accommodated?

dimensions.name: Spatial Anatomy & PMR Ergonomics
probes: Are PMR/ADA wheelchair turning circles (1500mm) respected throughout?
What is the maximum travel distance to the protected egress stair?
Where are MEP risers and structural transfer columns positioned?

dimensions.name: Bioclimatic & Environmental Vector Modeling
probes: What is the Solar Heat Gain Coefficient (SHGC) on the primary facade?
Is natural cross-ventilation verified by stack and pressure differentials?
What is the structural soil depth for vegetated surfaces?

dimensions.name: Recruiter Trust & 15-Second Ergonomics
probes: Can a reviewer verify your individual contribution in under 10 seconds?
Is there an uncropped 1:100 floor plan and 1:20 constructive wall section?
Are legal work authorization and contact coordinates immediately visible?

dimensions.name: Swiss Typographic & Grid Precision
probes: Does the layout snap strictly to an 8, 12, or 16-column modular grid?
Are all drawings accompanied by graphical bar scales?
Is there a consistent 4pt/8pt baseline grid driving typography?
